extDescription.message: Open PowerPoint, Excel, and Word links from your allowed SharePoint tenants directly in the Office desktop apps.

launchDialogHint.message: If your browser asks whether to open the app, choose “Open”.

launchResolvingHint.message: Asking SharePoint for the file location.

launchChooseHint.message: Choose how to open the file below.

errorTitle.message: Couldn't open in the Office app

errHostNotAllowed.message: This link belongs to a tenant that is not allowed.

errUnsupportedLink.message: This link format is not supported.

errExtensionMismatch.message: The link type does not match the file extension.

errOutsideSite.message: The file location points outside the linked site, so it can't be opened.

errNotSignedIn.message: You are not signed in to SharePoint, so the file location couldn't be checked. Open the link in the browser, sign in, and then open the link again.

errForbidden.message: You don't have access to this file, so its location couldn't be checked.

errNotFound.message: The file was not found (it may have been moved or deleted).

errTimeout.message: SharePoint did not respond in time.

optManaged.message: Some settings are managed by your organization and can't be changed.

optHostsNote1.message: Entering just a tenant name such as “contoso” is treated as

optHostsNote3.message: on a separate line. Links to hosts not listed here are never touched.

optAutoLaunch.message: Launch the app automatically (when off, choose with a button)

optCloseTab.message: Close the tab 4 seconds after launching

optCloseTabNote.message: Closing the tab is intended for environments where the AutoLaunchProtocolsFromOrigins policy suppresses the confirmation dialog. If the dialog is shown, it may close before you can choose.
